void_reason: Entry prices were read from synthetic (fabricated) price data, not real Binance market prices, due to a Binance fetch failure during a network outage on both nights. Grading these against real settle-date closes would produce meaningless WIN/LOSS outcomes and contaminate the meta-model's training corpus with backtest metrics computed on invented data.
